name: Maria
top_pain: Nobody can say who spent what: last quarter a £1,200 charge sat unexplained for two weeks, and the bookkeeper spends about 6 hours a week reconciling the two stores.
top_objection: We already have a corporate Visa from our bank.
ideal_opener: I noticed on Companies House you opened a second store on Deansgate in {{month:maria_store}}. Who's approving card spend across both stores now?
best_pitch_prop: Per-store virtual cards with auto-reconciled receipts.
closing_move: Two 20-minute slots: {{day0}} 10:00 or {{day1}} 10:30. Which works to walk through it with your bookkeeper?

name: Tom
top_pain: AWS and SaaS bills are in USD and nobody sees the FX cost until the statement lands. Every new hire waits on Tom for a card.
top_objection: We already use Brex — why would we switch?
ideal_opener: Saw your Series B in {{month:tom_series_b}} — congrats. How are you handling per-employee card issuance for the six engineers you're hiring?
best_pitch_prop: Team cards with per-card limits, and interbank FX on USD spend.
closing_move: {{day0}} 11:00 or {{day1}} 14:00 — happy to walk you and S.K., your finance lead, through the FX cost against your current Brex setup.

signals.content: Announced €15M Series B led by Northzone ({{monYear:tom_series_b}}).
Hiring 6 engineers and a finance operations analyst.
Filed allotment of shares — Series B confirmation ({{monYear:tom_series_b}}).

name: Emma
stage: Family-owned · operations head, reports to the MD
top_pain: Finance tags 400+ supplier card transactions a month by hand, because Xero can't read the job numbers.
top_objection: We need it to integrate with Xero — the last vendor said they could, and it broke.
ideal_opener: I saw Brightline's latest filing — headcount up 18% this year. Who's approving supplier card spend across the three sites now?
best_pitch_prop: Per-job-number cards with Xero line-level export and supervisor approval workflow.
closing_move: Could I get 20 minutes with you and your Xero admin: {{day0}} 14:00 or {{day1}} 11:30?

signals.content: Filed annual accounts — turnover up 22% and headcount up 18% year on year ({{monYear:emma_accounts}}).
Operations head shared a carousel: 'Lean manufacturing tools we use across our 3 sites.'

name: Lukas
top_pain: Each restaurant manager runs their own bank card, so supplier spend, including the monthly order from an Italian supplier, is invisible until invoices land. Last year one manager had to go over expense fraud.
top_objection: I don't trust new fintechs with my money.
ideal_opener: Tafelrunde added a fourth location in Schwabing in {{month:lukas_opening}} — wie regelt ihr Kartenausgaben über die Standorte hinweg im Moment?
best_pitch_prop: Per-location cards with weekly limits · EU-only data residency · receipt capture in the buyer's own language.
closing_move: 20 Minuten mit dir und deinem zentralen Buchhalter — {{day0:de}} 10:00 oder {{day1:de}} 09:30?

signals.content: Announced Schwabing opening on Instagram + LinkedIn ({{monYear:lukas_opening}}).
Featured in Süddeutsche Zeitung — 'four locations, one menu'.

name: Sven
top_pain: Supplier receipts arrive late, and the bookkeeper re-keys them by hand.
top_objection: Our accountant won't deal with another tool.
ideal_opener: How much time does your bookkeeping team spend re-keying supplier receipts every month?
closing_move: 20 minutes with you and your accountant: {{day0}} 10:00 or {{day1}} 15:00?
